description: Scores a resume against applicant tracking systems (ATS), for one posting or in general. Returns scores, keywords and suggestions. Changes nothing on the account. Uses AI credits. resume_text is optional and takes the text of a resume the user pasted or attached in the chat. Without it, the tool uses the resume already on the user's account. In ChatGPT, resume_file takes a resume file the user attached.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description (optional; without it, the score is a general ATS readiness score)

resume_file.description: A resume file the user attached in ChatGPT, as the file itself. GetMattered reads it once: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume. The resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation, as plain text. Left out, the resume already on the user's GetMattered account is used.

name: getmattered_score_resume

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

title: Score Resume
